recipients.list.title: List recipients

recipients.get.description: Retrieve one Stannp recipient by ID.
recipients.get.title: Get recipient

groups.list.description: List Stannp recipient groups with optional offset and limit pagination.
groups.list.title: List groups

accounts.balance.get.title: Get account balance
accounts.balance.get.description: Retrieve the current Stannp account balance. Use when you need to check available account funds.

users.me.get.title: Get current user
users.me.get.description: Get information about the currently authenticated user including rate limit status.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve details of a specific Stannp contact/recipient by ID.

contact_id.description: The ID of the contact to retrieve

recipients.create.title: Add recipient to group
recipients.create.description: Add a recipient to a recipient group. Use when you need to add new mailing list subscribers.

country.description: Recipient country code; defaults to GB on the platform if omitted

group_id.description: The ID of the recipient group to add the recipient to

recipients.delete.title: Delete recipient
recipients.delete.description: Permanently delete a recipient from your Stannp account.

id.description: ID of the recipient to delete

recipients.import.title: Import recipients
recipients.import.description: Import recipients from a CSV or XLS file into a Stannp recipient group.

file.description: Base64-encoded CSV or XLS file content, a file URL, or a binary payload

group_id.description: ID of the recipient group to import into

update_existing.description: Whether to update existing recipients if duplicates are found

groups.create.title: Create recipient group
groups.create.description: Create a new recipient group in Stannp. Use when you need to organize contacts before sending campaigns.

name.description: Name of the group (must be unique within your account)

groups.delete.title: Delete recipient group
groups.delete.description: Delete a recipient group in Stannp. Recipients remain on your account unless delete_recipients is true.

id.description: ID of the group to delete

delete_recipients.description: If true, completely delete all recipients in the group. Defaults to false.

groups.purge.title: Purge group
groups.purge.description: Remove all recipients from a mailing list. Recipients remain on your account if delete_recipients is false.

id.description: ID of the group to purge

delete_recipients.description: If true, completely delete all recipients. Defaults to false.

groups.recalculate.title: Recalculate group
groups.recalculate.description: Recalculate a group to ensure stats are up to date after adding or removing recipients.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to recalculate

groups.recipients.add.title: Add recipients to group
groups.recipients.add.description: Add existing recipients to a mailing list group.

group_id.description: ID of the group to add recipients to

recipients.description: Comma-separated list of recipient IDs to add to the group (e.g. '1,2')

groups.recipients.remove.title: Remove recipients from group
groups.recipients.remove.description: Remove recipients from a group without deleting them from your account.

group_id.description: ID of the group to remove recipients from

recipients.description: Comma-separated recipient IDs to remove from the group

campaigns.list.title: List campaigns
campaigns.list.description: Get a list of all Stannp campaigns.

campaigns.get.title: Get campaign
campaigns.get.description: Retrieve details of a specific campaign by ID.

id.description: ID of the campaign to retrieve

campaigns.create.title: Create campaign
campaigns.create.description: Create a new direct mail campaign with recipients and design templates. Requires a valid group_id with recipients.

back.description: A PDF or JPG file URL for the back image

file.description: A PDF file URL or binary for the design artwork

save.description: Save the uploaded file as a new design template

size.description: Required when using file or front/back. Example: A4, A5, A6

front.description: A PDF or JPG file URL for the front image

group_id.description: A group ID for the recipients

template_id.description: A template ID to copy. If left out, a blank template is used

what_recipients.description: Filter for what recipients to include in the campaign

campaigns.sample.create.title: Create campaign sample
campaigns.sample.create.description: Produce a PDF sample of your campaign. The generated link is valid for 30 minutes.

id.description: ID of the campaign to produce a sample for

campaigns.cost.get.title: Get campaign cost
campaigns.cost.get.description: Get the estimated cost of booking a campaign before dispatch.

id.description: ID of the campaign to get the cost of booking

campaigns.available_dates.get.title: Get campaign available dates
campaigns.available_dates.get.description: Get available dates for scheduling a campaign (up to 30 days).

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the date range query

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the date range query

letters.create.title: Create letter
letters.create.description: Create a letter with mail merge to insert address and variable data.

file.description: URL to a PDF/DOC file or base64-encoded file content. Alternative to template.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for reference, searchable in reporting

test.description: If true, produces a sample PDF without dispatching or charging. Defaults to false.

addons.description: Addon codes to upgrade your letter (e.g. FIRST_CLASS)

duplex.description: Set to false to print only on the front of each page. Defaults to true.

template.description: ID of a template already set up on the platform

clearzone.description: If true, overlay clear zones with white background. Defaults to true.

recipient_id.description: ID of an existing recipient in your account. Use this OR recipient_details, not both.

post_unverified.description: If false, the item will not be posted if the recipient address cannot be verified.

recipient_details.description: Detailed recipient information for creating a new recipient. Use this OR recipient_id, not both.

title.description: Recipient title, such as Mr or Mrs

zipcode.description: Recipient ZIP code (US alias for postcode)

url.description: Custom URL merge field for the recipient

postcards.create.title: Create postcard
postcards.create.description: Create a postcard. Use when you need to send a postcard via direct mail.

back.description: URL or path to back image (JPG or PDF)

test.description: Test mode - generates PDF but does not dispatch

front.description: URL or path to front image (JPG or PDF)

message.description: Message text to include on the postcard

template.description: ID of a template already set up on the platform

clearzone.description: If true, overlay clear zones with a white background

post_unverified.description: If false, do not post when the address cannot be verified

recipient.description: Recipient information including firstname, lastname, address1, city, zipcode, country

url.description: Custom URL merge field for the recipient

postcards.cancel.title: Cancel postcard
postcards.cancel.description: Cancel a postcard if processing has not started yet.

id.description: The ID of the postcard to cancel

selections.create.title: Create recipient selection
selections.create.description: Create an auto filter selection to target specific recipients within a group based on criteria.

name.description: Optional name for the filter selection to help identify it

filters.description: Specially formatted filter string: [column_name]:::[operator]:::[value]. Chain with :::AND:::.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to associate this selection with

folders.create.title: Create folder
folders.create.description: Create a folder in your secure file transfer area.

name.description: The name of the folder you wish to create

folders.list.title: List folders
folders.list.description: Get a list of folders in your secure file transfer area.

files.upload.title: Upload file
files.upload.description: Upload a file to your secure file transfer area. Supports URL-based imports and binary uploads.

file.description: File to upload. Can be a file or a URL string pointing to a remote file.

folder.description: A folder ID for placing the file in a specific folder

templates.list.title: List templates
templates.list.description: List all templates associated with the account.

mailpieces.list.title: List mailpieces
mailpieces.list.description: Retrieve mailpiece objects sent within a date range, optionally filtered by status or tag.

tag.description: Filter by custom tag associated with mailpieces

status.description: Filter by delivery status (e.g. delivered, returned, printing, local_delivery)

enddate.description: End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format

startdate.description: Start date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format

reporting.summary.get.title: Get reporting summary
reporting.summary.get.description: Get a status summary on individual items within a date range, including delivery and printing counts.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the reporting period

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the reporting period

pdfs.merge.title: Merge PDF files
pdfs.merge.description: Merge multiple PDF files into a single file. Provide at least two URLs.

files.description: An array of URLs for the PDF files to merge. Provide at least 2 URLs.

addresses.validate.title: Validate address
addresses.validate.description: Validate a postal address. Currently supports UK and US addresses only.

city.description: Address city. Required if zipcode is not provided.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 Alpha 2 country code (US, GB, CA, FR...)

zipcode.description: Address zipcode. Required if city is not provided.
